messages:
samir: Anyone else seeing a spike of failed SAML assertions from Okta since the deploy at 03:00 UTC? ~120/s errors hitting /sso/callback, proxy returning 503s.
devops-bot: Alert: 6178901240 - sso-proxy-5xx-rate - rate exceeded (120 errs/min) :warning:
elaine: I saw the dashboard too. Error pattern looks like assertion replay/ttl checks failing in the bridge, not straight 401. Logs show 'Assertion not yet valid' and 'Digest mismatch' intermittently.
jordan: Could be a clock skew or a signing key rotation? Any metadata refreshes scheduled?
samir: No planned key rotate. We did push an RBAC role rename in the same deploy which changed externalId behavior for service accounts. Not sure if that touches SAML attributes.
elaine: Sharing a snippet from the sso-proxy logs: ```
2026-03-21T03:02:12Z sso-proxy INFO incoming assertion for user=alice@example.com
2026-03-21T03:02:12Z sso-proxy WARN Assertion not yet valid (NotBefore 2026-03-21T03:02:15Z)
2026-03-21T03:02:12Z sso-proxy ERROR Digest mismatch verifying assertion signature
```
samir: Interesting — NotBefore a few seconds in the future. Could be clock skew on the IdP? But Okta uptime/metrics don't show clock drift.
jordan: Also noticed SCIM provisioning jobs backing up. Group sync windows are 5m batches; backlog might cause stale metadata consumed by the proxy. SCIM job logs: ```
2026-03-21T03:01:48Z scim-worker WARN provisioning queue depth=900 backlog=00:07:12
2026-03-21T03:01:49Z scim-worker ERROR KMS decrypt failed for externalId=svc-12345: DecryptError
```
elaine: KMS decrypt errors for service account extIDs could cause externalId to be blank in downstream assertions, which might trigger RBAC lookup fallthroughs and extra checks.
samir: So potential cascading chain: RBAC rename changed extID field mapping -> failing KMS decrypts -> provisioning backlog -> proxy sees assertions with mismatched digests or timing?
jordan: Less likely the digest itself is altered by SCIM, but if assertion consumer includes attributes that fail validation due to missing extID, we might reject early. Also replay/NotBefore errors point to time mismatch between proxies and Okta MFA.
security-oncall: Action plan: 1) Temporarily roll back RBAC rename config to old mapping. 2) Restart scim-worker pool to flush backlog. 3) Increase sso-proxy clock sync checks and add a short tolerance for NotBefore (+5s) until root cause found. Anyone can run the rollback?
elaine: I can push rollback to feature-flag for RBAC mapping in 2 mins. Recommend keeping it behind flag not full deploy.
samir: I'll take scim-worker restart (rolling) and tail the KMS error rate.
jordan: I can add a quick shim in sso-proxy to accept NotBefore within 5s and log counts. Put as emergency config change only.
devops-bot: Deploy started: rollback-rbac-mapping -> env=staging, user=elaine, ts=6178901420
elaine: Rolled feature-flag back in staging. Monitoring group sync and assertion error rate.
samir: Restarting scim-worker group: issuing rolling restart on 3 pods.
samir: Post-restart: KMS decrypt errors dropped from 40/min to ~1/min. backlog drained to 00:00:30.
jordan: Opted-in the NotBefore tolerance shim in sso-proxy (config only, no binary change). Watching digest-mismatch alerts.
elaine: Oncall/Okta team: can you confirm no metadata refresh happened? I checked the Okta log, no recent fingerprint changes.
security-oncall: Noted — open incident: INC-2026-031-ssoproxy. We've paused autoescalation but keeping page window open for 2 hours.
samir: After these actions assertion-related 503s dropped to baseline. Will run a postmortem tomorrow. For now keep RBAC mapping rolled back until we validate KMS key aliases and extID logic.
jordan: Followups: - add unit tests for extID decryption path - add alert for scim backlog >5m - record SSO NotBefore acceptance counts in telemetry
elaine: I'll own the RBAC config validation and do a canary reapply with feature-flag and end-to-end SCIM + SAML test.
security-oncall: Great. I'll create the postmortem stub and tag relevant owners. :white_check_mark:
